name: nuclear factor I C

function.text: NFIC is the approved symbol for nuclear factor I C. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription factor activity; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Hepatocellular carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NFIC have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
